chapter: Freelance and studio work in New York
title: Bonnie Lake and Ray Conniff in the Shaw band
summary: He names Jack Jenney's wife Bonnie Lake, who sang with Shaw and wrote the Dorsey Brothers theme, and recalls Ray Conniff.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: : I don't know her. If you say the name, I'd probably know it. Who was he married to then?
: All right, so Shaw goes in the Navy.
Bonnie -- she wrote -- the Dorsey Brothers when they had a band, she wrote the Dorsey Brothers theme, very talented girl. She's Ann Southern's sister.
: But she sang with Artie Shaw.
